test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

options.text: Mohan told Radha that he had seen her many times in the market since last year.
Mohan told Radha that he had seen her many times in the market since the following year.
Mohan told Radha that he had seen her many times in the market since the previous year.
Mohan told Radha that she had seen him many times in the market since the previous year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Mohan told Radha that he had seen her many times in the market since the previous year.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"since last year" becomes "since the previous year"**
